protocol.seed_scope: Fresh confirmation; frozen candidate selected before these trials
protocol.purpose: Compare frozen shared policies through pass, shoot and recovery; preserve all failures; no automatic promotion
protocol.success: Both kicks direction <=10 degrees, preferred foot, forward speed relative error <=0.30, no failure through 20 seconds
protocol.model_differences: Both skills can change; no shared pre-handoff action/prefix assumption
